correctness.rationale: An exhaustive orthogonal eigenspace decomposition yields the heat-kernel row differences for all part profiles. Explicit transport couplings and saturating graph-1-Lipschitz potentials prove the all-pairs W1 formula, including singleton and within-part cases. Monotonicity of the exact edge formula gives the attained global norm; direct differentiation proves its phase, peak and sharp universal limit. Independently, the included rational checker verified 111 finite graph/time instances and 1605 pairwise optima, without substituting finite tests for the analytic proof.

value.rationale: Exact W1 distances for every heat-row pair on all complete multipartite graphs with at least three parts and all real times form a natural complete semigroup-transport classification. The largest-part invariance shows that changing the distribution of smaller parts without altering N or their maximum leaves the full sharp graph-Lipschitz norm unchanged despite changed metric edges and generator. Equality data and exact transient amplification provide actionable stability benchmarks; the previously known phase threshold and bipartite special case are not treated as new.
